name: Elf Ranger
author: Johan Markström
description: Elf rangers work as scouts and spies beyond the borders of the high elf realms, tracking targets of interest and eliminating them where possible. As hired swords, they offer little in camaraderie, but plenty in murderous efficiency.

abilities.name: Fleet of Foot
abilities.text: Once per activation, this fighter can make a free move action.

abilities.name: Unerring Aim
abilities.text: Once per battle round, when this fighter makes a ranged attack action with a Bow or Elven Bow and hasn't made a move action yet in their activation, the weapon gains the Piercing 1 special rule.

abilities.name: Disengage
abilities.text: A fighter can only use this ability if they are within 1" of an enemy fighter. This fighter makes a free Retreat action.
